title: Design: Close window lists parts with no cost
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer with every line Complete and one part with no cost recorded, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-19-7d-close-parts-with-no-cost.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the internal work order.
  2. Click Close Work Order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The window lists the part under "Parts with no cost".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-E2: “If a part on the work order has no cost recorded, the confirmation lists it under "Parts with no cost" and posts the rest; the hub and QuickBooks entries carry the costed parts only.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
